objective: Maintain an external deep-validation harness for Kristal Framework without duplicating Kristal implementation semantics or writing into the target repository.
invariants: Store generated evidence under the harness repository by default.
Prefer native Kristal validators/builders/verifiers over duplicated implementations.
Perform destructive/adversarial mutations only in temporary copies.
Keep target mutation and network disabled by default.
Use stable finding IDs and bounded/redacted evidence.
Do not accept required SKIP/BLOCKED/PARTIAL/INFRA_ERROR as PASS.
Distinguish framework integrity, reference implementation conformance, ecosystem conformance and production qualification.
Treat missing executable EX/RP coverage as BLOCKED, not PASS.
recommended_sequence: fix target or harness according to evidence
